title: Create skill that fires only on glob-excluded file reads

cited_gaps.addressing_note: Sessions show wasted turns reading generated files. A skill filtering file reads could help.

why.prose_summary: A skill that intercepts file reads and filters them based on glob exclusion patterns would prevent wasted turns on generated files.

what.short_description: Create a skill that intercepts file reads and blocks access to glob-excluded paths.

how: The skill must fire on every file read and check whether the path matches a user-defined glob exclusion list, blocking the read if it does.
prediction: Sessions will no longer waste turns reading generated or excluded files.

authoring_addendum.purpose: Create a skill that intercepts file read tool calls and blocks reads to paths matching a configurable glob exclusion list.
authoring_addendum.activation_conditions: Must fire on every file read tool call and block the read before it executes if the path matches any exclusion glob.
behavior_constraints: Must intercept and block file read tool calls before they execute.
Must support configurable glob patterns for exclusion.
Must not allow any read of excluded paths, even partial reads.
Must fire on the Read tool's internal dispatch, not after the read completes.
examples: User reads dist/bundle.js -> skill blocks the read and returns a warning message.
authoring_addendum.style_hints: Match the structure of existing skills under .claude/skills/.
